VaultProfile.title: VaultProfile
VaultProfile.description: Zero-knowledge encryption key derivation metadata and verifier for a user's personal password vault.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vault owner.

salt.description: Base64-encoded PBKDF2 salt used to derive the AES-GCM vault key locally.

verifierIv.description: Base64-encoded AES-GCM initialization vector for the passphrase verifier.

verifierCiphertext.description: AES-GCM ciphertext of the known verifier string used to verify master passphrase locally.

autoLockMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before locking the decrypted vault in memory.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault profile was last updated.

VaultItem.title: VaultItem
VaultItem.description: An encrypted credential, card, Wi-Fi key, or secure note stored inside the owner's vault.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the item owner.

title.description: Display label for the vault item.

domain.description: Optional website hostname or service identifier.

isFavorite.description: Whether the item is pinned to favorites.

strengthScore.description: Local password strength score from 0 to 4.

hasTotp.description: Whether the encrypted payload contains a TOTP authenticator secret.

ciphertext.description: Base64-encoded AES-GCM encrypted payload containing username, password, url, notes, and TOTP secret.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated.

/vaultProfiles/{userId}.description: Stores each user's PBKDF2 salt, passphrase verifier, and vault preferences. Strictly restricted to the owning user.

/vaultProfiles/{userId}/items/{itemId}.description: Subcollection of client-side AES-GCM encrypted password vault entries owned by userId.
